attributes.title: read_tag_values
attributes.description: Reads the current (live) value, quality, and timestamp for one or more tags. Use this to check the present state of the line during or after an alarm flood -- e.g. whether a process value is still out of range, whether equipment has recovered, or what a station's status is right now. Paths without a [provider] prefix are assumed to be in the [default] provider. At most 50 paths per call. This is a read-only operation.

parameters.name: tag_paths
parameters.description: One or more tag paths, either comma-separated or as a JSON array string. Paths without a [provider] prefix are assumed [default], e.g. 'Exchange/Alarm Flood/Site1/Area1/Line1/Kitting/BinLevel'.
